headline: Claro Invests 19 Billion Pesos in 410-Kilometer Fiber Network in Colombia
summary: Claro has invested 19 billion Colombian pesos to construct a 410-kilometer fiber-optic network connecting Puerto Carreño in Vichada to La Primavera and Bogotá.
why: Claro Colombia, part of América Móvil, is the country's largest telecommunications carrier by wireless and broadband market share.

impacts.name: Claro Colombia
impacts.why: Claro completed a 19 billion peso capital investment to deploy 410 kilometers of fiber optic cable.
